about: The inputs the other six files never send.
Every other vector file is well-formed on purpose, and that turned out to
be a blind spot with a shape: a duplicated level name made `rank` return
one of two indices — same input, two answers — and that broke
WIDTH IS NOT HERE ON PURPOSE. An opinion holds as many debits as the host's
bitwise word, and both refuse rather than truncate. A shared vector at
a width one past the opinion would fail a correct implementation.

coverage.criterion: every refusal a carrier can produce, plus the two degenerate carriers that are still valid
coverage.why: refusals are enumerated from the error type, so a failure mode nobody thought to name is not here either

cases.name: one level is degenerate but valid
two levels is the shortest carrier that says anything
